knownLimits: The size is a deterministic estimate that has not been compared with the real tokenizer; no model was run. The local transport's measured prompt size is checked after each reply and recorded in the trace.
The cloud path has the estimate only.
A server that reports no prompt size leaves the estimate as the only check.
Id-level budget evidence is not durably stored; the trace holds counts, and the trace store is process memory.
Pipeline stages and the research engine use the pipeline's Ollama provider and are not budgeted by this guard.
The studio block and the conversation summary are mandatory; a request whose mandatory part exceeds the window is refused.

ownerActions.action: Set OLLAMA_NUM_CTX on every machine that runs AYAS chat. This workstation has 8192.
Set it in cloudflare/ayas-phone-gateway/wrangler.toml to the configured cloud model's window before the Worker is deployed again. The deployed Worker is unchanged.
Accept or reject the new retrieval evaluator identity.

authority: NONE: the budget decides what text is sent to a model. It grants no approval, lease, capability or spend.
